title: PPO · worked rank-32 LoRA recipe (collapsed)
analysis: Port of SkyRL's worked LoRA-PPO example to Qwen3-4B-Base and the DAPO math data: rank-32 LoRA policy and critic, use_kl_loss true, five samples per prompt, GAE (gamma 1.0, lambda 0.95), clip 0.2, policy and critic lr 3e-5, epochs 1, prompt 2048, response 8192, batch 256, AIME25+AIME26 (60 questions) eval. Stopped after 12 of 29 updates once the trajectory collapsed: mean response length exploded from 1.3k to 8.0k tokens, training correctness fell from 0.065 to 0.017, policy entropy rose 0.86 to 1.24 then collapsed to 0.19, and AIME25/AIME26 avg@8 fell to 0.42%/0.0%. The KL term was inactive (kl_loss_coef default 0.001, penalty about 1e-6) and the measured policy KL stayed small (at most 0.0068, then fell), so the collapse is length/objective driven, not drift away from the reference. Negative result: the worked recipe transfers to easy short GSM8K with a small Instruct model but does not transfer to hard long-response RL on a 4B base model. The 3e-5 LR is standard for LoRA and is not the cause.
